name: scout-compass
description: Repo-root manifest so the harness's deterministic edge (check.sh) actually gates the files this repo changes. check.sh walks up from the edited file to the first Cargo.toml/pyproject.toml/package.json/.git; before this file existed the walk from demo/ and bin/ stopped at the repo's .git, which matches no check branch — so edits to demo/seed-vault.mjs and bin/approve.mjs were UNGATED while the Day 1 write-up claimed they were wired (2026-08-02 invigilation finding 5). test delegates to the same hermetic suite server/package.json runs.
